title: Social presence and trust in shopping websites
statement:
Adding socially rich text and images that increase perceived social presence can increase trust and favorable attitudes toward shopping websites, giving teams several ways to make a digital purchase experience feel more human. (ScienceDirect)

Options:
- Named team members: team-portrait-and-name-card (fits: human, service led, relationship oriented)
- Human support cue: support-agent-photo-and-name (fits: support focused, high touch, reassuring)
- Customer story: customer-story-card (fits: community, social proof, relatable)
- Warm interface language: human-centered-microcopy (fits: friendly, approachable, service led)
- Contextual imagery: rich-lifestyle-product-imagery (fits: aspirational, emotional, experience led)
appliesWhen: Applies to: ecommerce, online retail, travel, online services. Audience: adults, general.

source.title: Manipulating perceived social presence through the web interface and its impact on attitude towards online shopping
